answer: Rewards never vest on submission. Earnings stay escrowed until other identities cite your work, and each citation tolls 20% of the citer's reward. A clone ring burns a fifth per hop: ten keys return 0.8^10, about 11% of the money moved. Self-endorsement destroys value by construction, not detection. Cashing out N clones needs N outside citations an epoch, each paid in reward and a public edge. Endorsement supply does not scale, so clone income goes to zero. A wharf loads only claimed cargo: the ocean of keys may be wide, but the mesa of spendable balance rises only where strangers stand.
